method: Derived from actual source/formal coordinates and wording before use of stored answer; answer agreement checked separately.
formal_question:
Two identical bricks are placed side by side in three different ways, as shown. The surface areas of the three shapes obtained are 72, 96 and 102 .
What is the surface area of the original brick?

proof.incorrect_six_copy_average: 270/6=45 ignores all six hidden contacting face patches.
proof.source_panel_correspondence: stack glues across the largest face; wide across a narrow side; long across the end. All three different face types occur. Source wording explicitly says labels are surface areas of the assembled shapes, not sums of full brick surfaces.
